provisions.body:
TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS FOR PERMITTED WEAPONS

All weights and sizes are in metric (kg,cm)

Bladed Weapons (Swords, Sabers, Falchions etc)   Weight   Length   Length of the Blade   Length of the Handle   Special Restrictions

Type 1 Bladed (arming swords, falchions, sabers)   1.1 - 1.7   72 - 100   60 - 80   12 - 20

Type 2 Bladed (longsword)   1.7 - 2.3   100 - 140   70 - 100   20 - 50   The Hilt should not extend more then 35mm over the Bearers hand.

Type 3 Bladed   2.3 - 3.0   120 - 160   90 - 130   30 - 50

Hafted Weapons(Polearm,Poleaxe,2-handed axe)   Weight   Length   Length of Striking Edge   Special Restrictions

Type 1 Hafted (Mace)   0.7 -1.3   50-70   >5

Type 2 Hafted (Axe) 0.7 - 1.3 50 - 90 >7 Type 1 Hafted (Maces) must have 6 or more flanges or be a ball. All Hafted weapons with sharp corners (Less than 90 degrees) and corners that can be considered dangerous are not permitted. Any point on the Striking Edge of the weapon Must have an angle more than 90
Type 3 Hafted (Longaxe)   1.3 - 2.5   90 - 130   >9   degrees.

Type 4 Hafted (Polearm)   2.2 - 3.2   130 - 220   >12

Outrance Bladed Weapons (Swords, Sabers, Falchions etc)   Calculation   Special Restrictions

Mens Balance Point of 15cm or more Outrance swords must also meet the Bladed Weapons Technical Requirements.
Balance points are measured from the edge of the grip zone and includes the crossguard.
Womens Balance Point of 10cm or more

Other Restrictions for all Weapon Types

The permissible upwards error for all weapons is 100g.
Heavier weapons or thrust weapons are not allowed under any circumstance.
The edge of all blades must be rebated and have a thickness of 2mm or more. This applies to striking and non-striking edges of all weapons.
The Radius of all edges must be more than 10mm.
Only Weapons which have chronological validity of a specific historical period as confirmed by the Authenticity Committee are allowed.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS FOR PERMITTED SHIELDS

All weights and sizes are in metric (kg and cm)

Heather and Punch Shields   Lenght   Width   Weight

Heater shield 55 - 75 30 - 65 ≤5
Punch shield   55 - 75   30 - 50

Round Shields and Bucklers   Diameter   Weight

Round shield 25 - 70 Buhurt ≤5 Buckler 20 - 70

Round Shield 25 - 35 Duel ≤5 Buckler 20 - 35

Other Restrictions for all Weapon Types All shapes must be conform with the Shields and Buckler rule document.
The Radius of striking edge must be more than 7 cm.
Only Shields which have chronological validity of a specific historical period as confirmed by the Authenticity Committee are allowed.
